title: Systems for Generative AI
weeklyTopics: Fine-tuning and alignment (LoRA, RLHF, instruction tuning)
Approximate nearest neighbor search and vector databases
Security risks of GenAI / training data extraction
skills: vector search / approximate nearest neighbor systems
workloadNotes: Seminar-style graduate course reading recent top-venue GenAI-systems papers. Grading: paper presentation 15%, paper summary 15%, participation 10%, project report 40%, project presentations 20%. Semester-long systems research project with mid-semester and final presentations. Explicitly NOT focused on AI methods themselves — focuses on the systems/infrastructure that support them.
prerequisitesText: Good programming skills and at least one undergraduate systems-related course (EECS 482 operating systems, EECS 484 databases, EECS 491 distributed systems, or EECS 489 networking). Undergraduate ML/AI background helpful but not required.
